facts.seen: Hisense 50H55E (China market), VIDAA 6 on Android 9, MStar/MTK SoC, 1.2 GB RAM
facts.decoders: HEVC and H.264 in hardware, one at a time, up to 3840x2160
facts.network: Ethernet ~750 Mbps measured to the Mac; 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi ~19 Mbps (too slow for 4K)

quirks.symptom: after a reboot every video app fails, including the receiver ('decoder busy')
quirks.cause: the middleware (hstvos) reopens the last input source (tuner or HDMI) at boot and never releases the only decoder
quirks.check: adb shell getprop persist.sys.last_source   (anything other than 2562)
quirks.fix: adb shell setprop persist.sys.last_source 2562, then reboot (ask first). Choosing TV or HDMI in the Source panel brings it back.

quirks.symptom: decoding fails while the stock home app's package is in front
quirks.cause: middleware keeps the decoder for that package
quirks.check: which package is resumed when it fails
quirks.fix: the receiver runs in its own package (tv.mactv.receiver); keep it that way

quirks.symptom: a third-party boot receiver never runs; pm disable-user of a system app comes back after reboot
quirks.cause: com.hisense.vidaaassistant disables components by name; part of the system restores packages at boot
quirks.check: adb shell pm list packages -d; reboot and compare
quirks.fix: don't rely on boot receivers; re-check disabled packages after a reboot

quirks.check: adb shell pm list packages -d | grep jamdeo
quirks.fix: never disable com.jamdeo.tv.vod; re-enable it if it was

quirks.symptom: volume set from the shell snaps back
Apple's Android TV app does not play
quirks.cause: Widevine L3 and an old WebView (66)
quirks.check: adb shell dumpsys package com.google.android.webview | grep versionName
quirks.fix: play Apple content through the Mac (apps/music)
